WITH avg_math_scores AS (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
    HAVING avg_math_score > 560
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CDSCode) AS num_charter_schools
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN avg_math_scores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.Charter = 'Yes';	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)`
    FROM schools AS s
    INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.City = 'Los Angeles' AND s.State = 'CA'
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 500 AND `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` < 700
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumberOfSchools
FROM c_rows;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH c_rows AS (
    SELECT cds, AvgScrMath, School, City
    FROM satscores AS ss
    INNER JOIN schools AS s ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.State = 'CA' AND s.City = 'Riverside' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400
)
SELECT s.School, s.FundingType FROM c_rows AS cr INNER JOIN schools AS s ON cr.cds = s.CDSCode;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH avg_read_scores AS (
    SELECT ss.cds, AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read_score
    FROM satscores AS ss
    GROUP BY ss.cds
)
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
JOIN avg_read_scores AS ar ON s.CDSCode = ar.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' AND s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY ar.avg_read_score ASC
LIMIT 1;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH min_math_score AS (
    SELECT MIN(AvgScrMath) AS min_avg_scr_math
    FROM satscores
),
school_with_min_math AS (
    SELECT ss.cds, sc.School, sc.County
    FROM satscores ss
    JOIN schools sc ON ss.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE ss.AvgScrMath = (SELECT min_avg_scr_math FROM min_math_score)
)
SELECT AVG(sat.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score, swc.County
FROM satscores sat
JOIN school_with_min_math swc ON sat.cds = swc.cds;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH city_selection AS (
    SELECT s.City, MIN(s.Latitude) AS MinLat
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.State = 'CA'
    GROUP BY s.City
),
school_info AS (
    SELECT s.School, s.GSoffered, sc.MinLat
    FROM schools s
    JOIN city_selection sc ON s.City = sc.City AND s.Latitude = sc.MinLat
    WHERE s.State = 'CA'
)
SELECT si.School, si.MinLat, MIN(si.GSoffered) AS LowestGrade
FROM school_info si
GROUP BY si.School, si.MinLat;	----- bird -----	california_schools

    WHERE district_id = 'A11'
),
c_cards AS (

)

    FROM client
    WHERE client_id = 992
),

    FROM loan
    WHERE account_id IN (

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_salary
    FROM client cl
    JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account acc ON d.account_id = acc.account_id
    JOIN trans t ON acc.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE cl.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT client_id, MAX(birth_date) AS max_birth_date
    FROM c_cols
    GROUP BY client_id
)
SELECT cc.client_id, cc.avg_salary
FROM c_cols cc
JOIN c_rows cr ON cc.client_id = cr.client_id AND cc.birth_date = cr.max_birth_date
ORDER BY cc.avg_salary ASC
LIMIT 1;	----- bird -----	financial

WITH b_cols AS (
    SELECT b.bond_type, b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
),
majority_bond AS (
    SELECT bond_type
    FROM b_cols
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
    GROUP BY bond_type
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
carcinogenicity AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN m.label IN ('Carcinogenic', 'Likely Carcinogenic') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
    FROM molecule AS m
    WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010'
)
SELECT mb.bond_type, cb.is_carcinogenic
FROM majority_bond AS mb
CROSS JOIN carcinogenicity AS cb;	----- bird -----	toxicology
